{{Quote|A university girl. I hate university girls. I think it’s time for you to shut up.|Pop-Dog trooper to Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] trooper in the [[Pop-Dogs]], a unit within the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was stationed at [[Borsk Fey'lya Army Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. One night, after [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Myri Antilles]] left [[Jokko Haning's Emporium]] while working undercover as a [[nester]], the trooper followed her and insisted on escorting her home. When Antilles refused and insulted the Pop-Dogs, he pursued her into an alley, seized her, and attempted to intimidate her. Antilles responded by breaking one of his fingers before stunning him with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and leaving him unconscious.<ref name="MK" />
